messages:
mina: heads-up: production alert 09:12 UTC: a subset of SSE clients received duplicate event payloads when reconnecting after keepalive resets. looks correlated with yesterday's keepalive policy change.
sam: are these billing duplicates or just client-visible repeats?
mina: both in some cases. small sample trace pasted: 
```
2026-04-02T09:12:07Z conn=sse-77 client=web-88 last_ping=19s keepalive_config=20s prox_close=edge-7 reason=idle_timeout
2026-04-02T09:12:07Z conn=sse-77 reconnect=1 resume_token=rt:xy12 seq=204 billing.charge=chg_z12 dedupe=miss
```
yousef: sounds like an effective keepalive mismatch between edge and upstream proxy caused an early close + route reassignment. resume accepted on new pool without original route metadata so dedupe failed.
tay: current dedupe key = (tenant, session_id, route_id, token). route flip breaks it.
sam: short term: can we widen server-side dedupe TTL to 2s for resumes that immediately follow an eviction? cheap guard.
yousef: agreed. medium term: two options: A) include signed origin_fingerprint in resume token (edge id + epoch) so billing can fallback, or B) maintain tiny kvcache table mapping (tenant, session, seq)->last_charge for 30s. both have tradeoffs (token churn vs extra RPC).
mina: dashboard/console issue: SREs only see reconnect spikes but not which reconnects caused charges. need a per-tenant "resume.dupe_rate" timeseries and a new event tag when prox_close includes keepalive mismatch.
tay: implementation plan: 1) emit edge.telemetry.keepalive_effective on close with configured value. 2) add server-side 2s dedupe grace for prox-eviction resumes (flagged). 3) prototype small kvcache dedupe behind feature flag. 4) console: surface resume.dupe_rate + keepalive mismatch annotation.
sam: rollout: telemetry emit first (48h) to baseline. then enable dedupe grace on edge in canary. then kvcache canary 5%. protocol token change later if needed.
mina: ops: please roll back keepalive to previous 15s in eu-west canary while we triage.
ops-bot: rolled back keepalive to 15s in eu-west at 09:30 UTC. INF-7034 created to track the fixes and runbook updates.
yousef: QA: need a query to find tenants where resume.attempt && billing.dedupe=miss && edge.keepalive_effective != configured. I'll add it to INF-7034.
tay: console mock in PR to show red eviction tag + tooltip "evicted due to keepalive mismatch -> possible duplicate charge". small panel for resume.dupe_rate per-tenant.
sam: ok. timelines: telemetry + small rollback = today. edge dedupe grace + kvcache proto = 1.5 weeks. console patches 3-4 days.
mina: thanks all. I'll follow up with PR links and the exact query in the INF ticket. :thumbsup:
